session_metadata.phase: Weeks 3-4 Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) Final Audit

analytical_milestones.finding: Maintained raw NaN entries for all missing fields across the 41-project registry to guarantee that descriptive parameters capture actual recorded metrics without distortion.
Verified that runtime calculations dynamically drop incomplete data pairs per variable subset rather than using row-wise pruning, ensuring maximum sample utilization.
Confirmed that the zero-sum nature of percentage bounds creates an inverse tracking pattern where dominant, high-inspection crafts pull secondary discipline percentages down on high-rework jobs.

Piping.risk_assessment: Primary positive tracking attribute. Directly correlates with intensive weld validation, CWI procedures, and pressure-testing quality oversight.

Structural.risk_assessment: Extremely weak inverse trending near absolute statistical zero. Successfully insulated from structural rounding truncations via six-decimal display.

Equipment.risk_assessment: Linear profile tracking downwards due to data mix constraint; ranking divergence thoroughly traced to extreme outlier alignments on tight sample variances.
